prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original fan-made production sprite sheet for a side-view tactical video game, faithful to Metal Gear Solid V The Phantom Pain (1984). EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly 16 independently DRAWN full-body poses of ONE same character. Pure flat magenta #FF00FF canvas with five thin continuous pure cyan #00FFFF vertical grid lines and five horizontal grid lines, including outer boundaries. Each equal square cell must contain exactly one complete character, wholly inside, generous empty margin at least 30 pixels, no extremity or equipment on guides. Fixed camera, strict orthographic RIGHT-facing profile, feet bottom aligned, identical physical scale every frame. Detailed crisp military pixel art, clear small-scale silhouette, no scenery, no ground shadow, no text, no labels, no logos, no watermark. The sixteen poses must be genuinely different drawings, never simple shifted duplicates. Four phases per row in left-to-right time order, preserve all costume and identity features in EVERY pose. Keep weapons and hands compact inside their cell. Subject: Paz Ortega Andrade as the ADULT hospital-memory apparition in MGSV The Phantom Pain 1984, NOT the Peace Walker schoolgirl outfit and NOT a living resurrected soldier. Faithful to Konami/Shinkawa MGSV Paz hospital concept: short wavy light-blonde bob framing gentle pale adult face, narrow cloth bandage around forehead, light desaturated teal medical bandeau and matching modest medical shorts, loose dark teal hospital cardigan/robe draped over shoulders reaching mid-thigh, white gauze wrap on one forearm and right shin, bare feet. Neutral nonsexual convalescent posture, no exposed wound. No school uniform, no weapon, no ponytail. Row1 four quiet standing breathing phases with cardigan hanging naturally. Row2 four slow tentative right-facing walking stages, compact feet with mild knee change. Row3 four stages holding and inspecting a small plain rectangular photograph close to chest, no legible photo content. Row4 four slight tired forward hunch and recovery poses, hands resting near abdomen over cloth, no death. All 16 poses independently drawn and right-facing, same adult face and wavy bob. No surrounding glow, ghost effects, detached particles or icons; this is an archive visual memory depiction only.
